description: List prediction markets on Lucyd. Each market asks whether the BTC price will be Up or Down at its end date versus the strike (strike is the price times 1e8). Returns address (the market id), state, period, start and end dates, strike, winner and volume.

limit.description: How many markets to return, 1 to 100. Default 20.

offset.description: Skip this many markets, for paging.

order.description: Sort by end date: asc or desc. Default desc.

period.description: Market period: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h or Daily. Comma separated for several.

state.description: Market state: open, pending (ended, waiting for result), settled or voided. Comma separated for several.

name: list_markets
title: List markets
